_comment: Dummy GAME_EVENT packets for the mock gateway (python3 tools/mock_gateway.py --dummy).
Each is a real GAME_EVENT as defined in Docs/GATEWAY_PROTOCOL.md; the gateway fills in
type, protocol_version, session_id, event_id, window_id and timestamp, then sends one
chosen at random every --every seconds (or on 'r' in --keys mode).
Edit this file while the gateway runs: it is re-read automatically on the next pick.
Fields you may set: action (stand|walk|jump|squat|fireball|stomp), confidence (0..1),
and optionally event_id / window_id / session_id to force duplicates or other sessions.
